title: Line sketch: Mystical Vortex Island
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A glowing central island sits within a swirling vortex of water, surrounded by lush mountains under a starry sky. Beams of light and energy connect the vibrant landscape to a bright star above (derived from painting #800).
